message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/18592/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To objectively assess for pleural effusion and screen for osseous abnormalities (e.g., rib fractures) that automated tools might detect, providing a baseline against visual inspection."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/18592/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain a detailed textual description of the left-sided opacity and specifically check for mentions of rib fractures or bone lesions, which are critical for distinguishing haemothorax from other effusions given the clinical context."}], "reason": "The question requires correlating a specific finding (pleural effusion) with potential osseous pathology to explain chest pain.
